## Goal
- Fix the REAL production mobile owner sign-in (phone still returns Supabase `AuthApiError invalid_credentials` HTTP 400) per the owner's 12-step mandate: rotate the exposed password securely, verify phone vs server Supabase project, fix the exact mobile `signInWithPassword` path, build a new APK, physical-device test, and correct the false QA record; secondary: finish the IVX IA iOS app.

## Constraints & Preferences
- **PREVIOUS "VERIFIED" QA REPORT IS INVALID** — owner mandates status `OWNER LOGIN STATUS: FAILED` / `PRODUCTION STATUS: PARTIAL` until the real phone UI login succeeds; no more narrative PASS reports
- **SECURITY FIRST**: owner password was exposed in screenshots/chat — NEVER print/persist any password again (not in chat, logs, reports, fixtures, source, agent-state.json, Git, API responses); rotation must go through secure reset flow; owner must NOT paste new password into chat
- Only the exact mobile path counts as proof: `supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({email, password})` — no JWT substitution, service-role, magic link, admin tokens, session injection, or /health-based claims
- Password input must be preserved exactly (no trim/lowercase/normalize); email may be trimmed+lowercased
- Log only safe metadata (timestamps, project ref, masked email, status, error code, user ID, method, commit)
- Acceptance requires: rotated password, correct project ref on phone, mobile path succeeds, owner routes open, invalid password fails, non-owner 403, session persistence, logout works, fresh APK passes on physical Android
- Expo/React Native is the ACTIVE production app; Kotlin `android-ivx-holdings/` abandoned; use `bun`/`bunx`
- Owner token expires ~15 min — refresh via `POST /api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login`
- Private env vars not in agent shell — route writes via production backend `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action`

## Progress
### Done
- **Backend password-preserving fix DEPLOYED**: commit `7a25832132f615d3ac8e2d69ea372e6805f9c927` on main via developer-deploy `github_commit_file` (confirmText `CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE`); live health shows commit `7a258321`; passwordless login returns marker `ivx-owner-passwordless-login-password-preserving-2026-07-17`, `sessionMethod=magiclink_token_hash`, `passwordPreserved=True`
- **Env var added + redeployed**: `IVX_OWNER_REGISTRATION_EMAILS=iperez4242@gmail.com` via `render_upsert_env_var` (confirmText `CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE`) + `render_trigger_deploy` (confirmText `CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY`, deploy `dep-d9d6ms0k1i2s73d2uan0`, boot 2026-07-17T17:52:04Z); Render serviceId `srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0`
- **Owner password set once** via `POST /api/ivx/owner-access-repair` (V7 backend, `requiresClientPassword=True`, `passwordUpdateSource=client_request`) — that password is now EXPOSED and must be rotated
- **Sandbox QA (now INVALIDATED as proof)**: direct Supabase `grant_type=password` succeeded repeatedly (HTTP 200, user `9b280e15-f9fd-459f-bf2d-530b1ed84cb1`); passwordless→password stress cycles passed; wrong password correctly rejected 400 — but real phone still fails
- **Secret purge (partial)**: all /tmp secret-bearing files deleted; exposed password found hardcoded in 2 repo files: `backend/ivx-owner-registration-supabase-mismatch.test.ts` (`TEST_PASSWORD`) and `expo/scripts/audit-owner-ai-members-live.mjs` (`OWNER_PASSWORD` + hardcoded service-role key + owner token)
- **Config mapping started**: production Supabase = `kvclcdjmjghndxsngfzb` (URL + anon fallback baked into `expo/lib/supabase-env.ts`); OLD project ref `biikwnqdhsdzyxecekht` appears only in test files; app.config.ts version `1.4.5` / versionCode `37`; mobile reset flow = `supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail` at `expo/app/login.tsx:759`; UI auth path = `expo/lib/auth-password-sign-in.ts` → `client.auth.signInWithPassword` (line 42)
